meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能从 H&E 切片图像预测基因表达：输入 224x224 像素的图块，按基因符号查询，输出每个基因在每个图块的表达值（log1p-CPM）；支持约 19k 个蛋白编码基因，还能对整张切片预测并生成虚拟空间转录组图谱。
howto.when: 当用户需要从 H&E 切片获取空间基因表达（log1p-CPM，224x224 图块，约 20x），或想按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因，或需要对整张切片进行预测时触发。

say.text: 请用这张 H&E 图块预测 EPCAM 和 CD3D 的表达。
say.note: 返回这两个基因在该图块的 log1p-CPM 值。

say.text: 换用 evo2 嵌入来源，重新预测这些基因。
say.note: 会改用基因组序列嵌入计算表达。

howto.what_en: Claude can predict spatial gene expression from H&E tiles: input a 224x224 tile and gene symbols, get log1p-CPM values per gene. Covers ~19k protein-coding genes; whole-slide prediction yields a virtual spatial transcriptomics map.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs spatial gene expression from H&E tiles (log1p-CPM, 224x224 tiles, ~20x), wants to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or needs whole-slide prediction after histolab tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression from this H&E tile.
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM values for these two genes on that tile.

say_en.text: Tile this whole slide with histolab, then predict EPCAM and CD3D and output the map.
say_en.note: Produces a virtual spatial transcriptomics matrix for the slide.

say_en.text: Switch to the evo2 embedding source and re-run prediction for these genes.
